essence: SessionWork.find_snaps (SessionWork.js:61) fetches every day's index.json from a task folder's day to today, up to 31 fetches. In a clean checkout those gitignored files are missing, so the session and task pages fail the merge smoke on 404s. A dated allow-list entry (Server/console-allow.jsonl, until 2026-11-01) covers it for now.
fix: Ask the dev server which day folders hold an index.json (the same folder-listing call the console sweep moved the other pages to), and fetch only those; or read the one session-index.json, which already carries each session's day. Then delete the allow-list entry.
